sources.title: Scene understanding using vision language models
sources.snippet: Using Large Language Models (LLMs) for scene understanding in AV can present challenges. The daily generation of terabytes of data by vehicles makes scalable image analysis difficult from a computational point of view. Small Language Models (SLMs) are more efficient but lack the domain knowledge required for effective scene analysis and need fine-tuning on domain-specific data.

sources.title: GPT4Scene
sources.snippet: To address this, we introduce GPT4Scene, a novel visual prompting paradigm in VLM training and inference that helps build the global-local relationship, significantly improving the 3D spatial understanding of indoor scenes.

sources.title: 3D understanding - 3D AI Lab
sources.snippet: This includes 3D reconstruction and semantic understanding from commodity RGB-D sensor data, leveraging generative 3D deep learning towards enabling understanding and interaction with 3D scenes for content creation and virtual or robotic agents.

sources.title: SceneFun3D
sources.snippet: We introduce SceneFun3D, a large-scale dataset with highly accurate interaction annotations in 3D real-world indoor environments. Abstract Existing 3D scene understanding methods are heavily focused on 3D semantic and instance segmentation.
